warnings: Steel roof trusses: both use the same member sizes; they differ only in support layout — T2 (grids 4-6) bears on rows ก, ข and the CX1 post line ข' (2.40 past ข, 2.20 overhang), T1 bears on rows ก, ข, ค (3.00 past ข, 1.60 overhang). Total eave-to-eave 12.20 in both, matching the roof plan ก' to ค''.
Truss member sizes are kept as separate *_section objects on the one truss element (top chord = steel_section) instead of an array of members.
Rise printed only as '~1.40'; no absolute level is printed on this sheet, so nothing was added to the grid master z_levels.
